summary: S10 Prep & Serve Time Report (Gate 4 - Live API wiring) verified working. All features functional: KPI strip shows real data (Avg Prep 17min, Avg Serve 14min, Avg Total 26min), Escalation Matrix shows 'Coming Soon' placeholder, Mode breakdown badges (Kitchen: 329, Bar: 0, Direct: 242), Overview tab with daily/hourly/distribution charts, By Item tab with real Pav items (Aloo Parantha, Pav Bhaji, etc.), By Station tab with KDS/PACKAGED/OTHER cards and mode breakdown badges, Date picker with presets (Today, 7D, 30D, MTD) and Apply button all working.
critical_code_review_comments: prepServeService.js correctly classifies items by timestamp patterns: Kitchen (prep gap >30s), Bar (instant ready, real serve), Direct (no timing)
Cancelled items (food_status=3) correctly excluded from timing calculations
30-second threshold (THRESHOLD_MIN = 0.5) used for classification is appropriate
Parallel chunk fetching with PARALLEL_LIMIT=3 for efficient data loading
PrepServeTimeMockup.jsx has proper data-testid attributes for all key elements
Mode breakdown badges correctly show Kitchen/Bar/Direct counts from modeCount object
